#!/usr/bin/python
import os, sys, time
base = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
for number in range(int(sys.argv[1])):
    pid = os.fork()
    if pid == 0:
        time.sleep(0.1)
        os._exit((number % 2) * 3)
time.sleep(15)
